basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old living in Southern California. By day, I'm a junior high school art teacher, and by night, I'm an avid crafter and DIY enthusiast. I love exploring new hobbies, like polymer clay modeling and video gaming, particularly titles like Returnal. I'm in a relationship with my partner of 3 years, and we often enjoy watching Avatar: The Last Airbender together. I usually browse Reddit during evenings and weekends when I'm not lesson planning or working on my latest craft project.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor of Fine Arts and a minor in education. My knowledge is mostly self-taught through online resources and trial and error. I love learning and sharing insights on crafting and creative teaching methods.
